preferences.question: How packed should each day be?
preferences.user_value: Slow. One or two activities a day with plenty of free time.

description: Control for trip-pace-plain-corrected. Same turns, but turn 1 asks a neutral question instead of correcting the pace, so turns 2-4 show the model's uncorrected default. Variant of trip-pace: turn 2 drops "in more detail", to test whether asking for detail is what makes the plan creep.
